notes.color_behavior: Each collection has its own application palette. App-specific SVGs use their palette, and shared icons point to one maintained SVG pair so a common icon is not copied into every app.
notes.visuals: 2D and 3D variants are presented side by side. V9 motion assets are optional previews; static icons remain the default.
notes.coverage: V2-V8 shared libraries are linked from the relevant app galleries. V9-V15 contain cafe, TV, launcher, RS TV, developer and audio collections. App-specific icons found in the application drawable audit are included.
